notes.title: Our Demo is now available for Android Phones!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708819/f7e5645a574dab8c3d6b492a7d14cc5949ac7a40.png[/img]

Hey Guys!! We're so excited to tell you our Demo is now available for download at Google Play Store! It's a great milestone for us bringing more accessibility for our game even if it means putting it in another platform!

Download Link: https://bit.ly/ScarletManorPlayStore

So download it and give your feedback!! We'd love to see what you guys think about it!
